verdict.rationale: 2FAS gives users strong control over where their data lives. Users choose their own cloud or an encrypted local file, can self-host, and need no registration. The browser extension does not keep items permanently in browser memory or on third-party servers. For retention specifically, 2FAS Share offers automatic link expiration and one-time access, but nothing documents how users delete synced or backed-up vault data, or what retention guarantees apply. Missing for 10: documented deletion workflows for vault and backup data, explicit retention policies for synced or cloud data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
